description: This file contains Kotlin enum classes defining various constants and command values for different device capabilities and actions within the OpenClaw protocol package.

classes.name: OpenClawCapability
classes.description: Enum representing various device capabilities that can be referenced within the OpenClaw protocol.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasCommand
classes.description: Enum for canvas-related commands such as present, hide, navigate, etc.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UICommand
classes.description: Enum for canvas A2UI commands like push, pushJSONL, and reset.

classes.name: OpenClawCameraCommand
classes.description: Enum for camera actions such as list, snap, clip.

classes.name: OpenClawSmsCommand
classes.description: Enum for SMS commands like send and search.

classes.name: OpenClawLocationCommand
classes.description: Enum for location-related command to get location info.

classes.name: OpenClawDeviceCommand
classes.description: Enum for device-related commands such as status, info, permissions, health.

classes.name: OpenClawNotificationsCommand
classes.description: Enum for notification commands like list and actions.

classes.name: OpenClawSystemCommand
classes.description: Enum for system commands such as notify.

classes.name: OpenClawPhotosCommand
classes.description: Enum for photo commands like latest.

classes.name: OpenClawContactsCommand
classes.description: Enum for contact-related commands including search and add.

classes.name: OpenClawCalendarCommand
classes.description: Enum for calendar commands such as events and add.

classes.name: OpenClawMotionCommand
classes.description: Enum for motion detection commands like activity and pedometer.

classes.name: OpenClawCallLogCommand
classes.description: Enum for call log commands, specifically search.
